items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I told George Simon way later, I said, you know, I think I know you're right

ctx.x: Now what about Joe Keyes? Jo Jones has spoken very highly to me about him as a musician.
He was a very good musician. Very good trumpet player. But he always played a bad horn. He never did have a good trumpet. He always played a little bit out of tune.
